subject: general
question: As per Annual Status of Education Report (rural) – 2021, what was the enrolment rate of children enrolled in government schools in the year 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**70.3%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Annual Status of Education Report** is a citizen-led survey that is household based rather than school-based so that the children are not enrolled in or dropped out.
 
• The **16th Annual Status of Education Report (Rural) 2021 or ASER 2021 was released on Wednesday, November 17. Similarly, the reports of 2021 show that the enrolment rate of children enrolled in government schools in the year 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In anticipation of the** COVID-19 epidemic in 2020, ASER **created a brand-new design that included a phone-based survey to examine children's access to educational options. The format used for **ASER 2021** was also this one.
 
• The survey was carried out in 25 states and 3 Union Territories during September and **October 2021.**
 
• It reached a total of 7,299 government schools with primary grades,** 76,706 homes, and 75,234 kids **between the ages of **5 and 16**. It also reached the teachers or head teachers at those institutions.
